notes: Variant assumption is a strict bodyweight chin-up with a supinated fixed-bar grip. The entry intentionally separates chin-up from pronated pull-up because the hand position changes elbow-flexor emphasis and tolerance. Brachialis is not shown because the exact pull-up/chin-up sources do not isolate it cleanly enough for the visible map.
